detail: Full summary: scripts/calibrate-tokenizer.mjs aborted the whole calibration run on test/fixtures/tokenizer-corpus/whitespace.txt (31 bytes, all whitespace) because the count-tokens API refuses an empty text block. Fixed by skipping blank documents and excluding them from the corpus hash, byte total and document count. NOT RUN here — no API key on this machine — so the fix is unverified against the live API; the proven 1 token/byte bound still ships.
